# The Affordable Way

> > The Affordable Way offers flexible rent-to-own options for furniture, appliances, and electronics across 35 locations in Louisiana, Texas, and Mississippi.

The Affordable Way has been serving customers since 1989 with a wide selection of name-brand products from Ashley Furniture, Samsung, LG, and other major manufacturers. The company specializes in making home furnishings and appliances accessible through affordable monthly payment plans.

## Product Categories

- [Rent to Own Furniture](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture): Rent to own furniture catalog featuring Ashley, Crown Mark, and Albany brands
- [Rent to Own Appliances](https://www.theaffordableway.com/appliances): Rent to own appliances including refrigerators, washers with monthly payments
- [Rent to Own Electronics](https://www.theaffordableway.com/electronics): Rent to own electronics from Samsung, LG, Sony, Apple with flexible plans

## Living Room Furniture

- [Living Room Furniture](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture/living-room): Living room furniture including sofas, sectionals, recliners from Ashley

- [Recliners](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture/living-room/recliners): Recliners from Ashley and Home Stretch with affordable monthly payments
- [Chairs](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture/living-room/chairs): Chairs from Ashley Furniture and Mac Motion with rent to own options
- [Fireplaces](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture/living-room/fireplaces): Fireplaces from Ashley and Twin Star with flexible rental payment plans
- [TV Consoles](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture/living-room/tv-consoles): TV consoles from Ashley, Legends, Twin Star with monthly payment options
- [Occasional Tables](https://www.theaffordableway.com/furniture/living-room/occasional-tables): Occasional tables from Ashley Furniture with affordable rent to own plans

- [myPay-Less Account Login](https://www.theaffordableway.com/account): Customer account login portal for myPay-Less rental management

- [Store Locations](https://www.theaffordableway.com/locations): Store locator for 35 locations across Louisiana, Texas, Mississippi
